metadata.change_reason: Structured template for acceptance criteria, test suites, and DoD verification gates

sections.title: Overview
sections.content_hint: Coverage of functional REQs with explicit rationale for any omissions

sections.title: Functional Acceptance Criteria
sections.content_hint: Every REQ must contain happy, boundary, and error scenarios with assertable Then clauses

sections.title: Non-Functional Acceptance Criteria
sections.content_hint: Performance thresholds must reflect PRD targets with concrete numeric bounds

sections.title: Integration Test Acceptance Criteria
sections.content_hint: End-to-end integration across modules and platforms

sections.title: Test Data Requirements
sections.content_hint: Five boundary classes: minimum, min-1, maximum, max+1, and null/empty

sections.title: Defect Severity & Release Gates
sections.content_hint: Four-tier defect taxonomy (critical/major/minor/trivial) and zero-open-blocker release gate

sections.title: Acceptance Criteria Priority
sections.content_hint: Mandatory release criteria versus deferrable criteria
